title: Mount Everest's Official Height Was Wrong for 65 Years, Until ...
snippet: Sep 7, 2026 · Everest is 8,848.86 metres above sea level. That figure only became official on 8 December 2020, when the foreign ministers of Nepal and China pressed a button at the same moment during a livestreamed ceremony and revealed a number neither country had published before. For 65 years, the world had been climbing, filming and writing about a mountain whose exact height nobody could actually agree on.

title: Mount Everest - Wikipedia
snippet: In 2010, both sides agreed that the height of Everest is 8,848 m, and Nepal recognises China's claim that the rock height of Everest is 8,844 m. [41] On 8 December 2020, it was jointly announced by the two countries that the new official height is 8,848.86 metres (29,031.7 ft). [42][43]

title: Do both China and Nepal now agree on the height of Mt Everest?
snippet: Aug 6, 2024 · On December 8, 2020, Nepal and China jointly announced the officially agreed height of Mt. Everest: 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 feet). This figure includes both the rock height and the snow and ice cap.
